fact: Togo Officiel reports on 28 April 2025 that free roaming between Togo, Benin and Ghana, in effect for some months, was assessed by consumer associations on 19 to 22 March 2025, with calls from Yas Togo and Moov Africa Togo succeeding 100 percent of the time in Ghana and Benin.
title: Free roaming entre le Togo et ses voisins : des performances enregistrées
publisher: Site officiel du Togo, République Togolaise
